title_original: Obras de Paso de Carreteras. Colección de tramos con vigas pretensadas. Tipo HP 1
sheet_series_original: Colección de vigas tipo HP-1 — Dirección General de Carreteras
title_en: Road crossing structures. Collection of spans with prestressed beams, type HP-1
approval: Orden de 9 de febrero de 1977 (Ministerio de Obras Públicas), BOE núm. 118, 18 mayo 1977, pp. 10886-10915
status_notes: Approved by Orden 9 Feb 1977; use was declared non-obligatory (apartado 2.º). An earlier project registry states it was annulled in 1985; that supersession was not independently audited. Do not describe as a current standard.
units: metres (source); m2/m and m3/m for Mediciones
drawing: SECCION I-I (midspan section) on each 'VIGA TIPO n - ENCOFRADOS Y ARMADURAS PASIVAS' sheet; scanned 300 dpi JBIG2, read from native-resolution crops
geometry_notes: Straight-line doble T outline exactly as drawn in SECCION I-I: no fillets or chamfers are drawn or dimensioned.

Vertical chain (top to soffit): top flange edge, top splay, web, bottom splay, bottom flange edge; each chain closes exactly to the printed canto total and matches the chain on the SEMIALZADO LONGITUDINAL elevation.
Only the central (midspan) section is modelled. End blocks (ensanchamiento/blochet) at the supports and the riostra are excluded.

Validation: gross area vs 'Mediciones - Sección central - Hormigón' m3/m (= m2 of section) within 3-decimal rounding for all six types (max 0.045%). Independent second check: 'Molde' m2/m equals the outline perimeter minus the top face within 2-decimal rounding.
No published centroid or inertia exists in the source; yb and I are analytic only.

IV.reading_note: Top width callout '1,00' is faint in the scan; confirmed by the area and molde checks.
